notes.title: Milo and The Christmas Gift - Update 1.1.
notes.notes:
First of all a huge thanks to everyone that has played the game and also a Happy New Year! It was so amazing to see everyone play during and after Christmas after our surprise release. By the way: did you find all the secrets? :)

Please consider leaving Milo and Toby a Christmas gift this year by leaving a review to let us know what you think!  

Below you can find the patch notes for Update 1.1.

Patch Notes 1.1


 Improved flow of puzzles
 Several puzzles improved hints
 Several translation issues
 Small bug fixes


Ps. We just announced our upcoming adventure: Follow the meaning! Feel free to wishlist: Follow the meaning
